// A typed function per route of each HTTP server, sending its arguments and

import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/** Runs proc B: `POST /api/b` on http server web-api. */
export async function b(args: { readonly i: number }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/b", {
    "i": $encInt(args.i),
  }, opts);
  return $decInt(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_T(x: $t.T): unknown {
  return {
    "x": $encInt(x.x),
  };
}

export function $dec_T(v: unknown, at: string): $t.T {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    x: $decInt($field(o, "x", at), at + ".x"),
  };
}

export function $enc_BArgs(x: $t.BArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "i": $encInt(x.i),
  };
}

export function $dec_BArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.BArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    i: $decInt($field(o, "i", at), at + ".i"),
  };
}

==== hooks.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";

/**
 * Runs proc B through b (`POST /api/b` on http server web-api): with args,
 * whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useB(args?: { readonly i: number } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly i: number }, number> {
  return $useCall($c.b, args, opts);
}
